As you have taken the solemn declaration, you are now a witness of justice, and neither party may interfere. That is why there is this prohibition on any contact with the Prosecution or the Defence. Therefore, we would like to wish you an enjoyable weekend, and Madam Usher is going to escort you out of the courtroom and invite you to come back on Monday at 2.15.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] As we have some time available, regarding the planning for next week, it was discussed at length, but to make sure there's no confusion, Mr. Withopf, could you tell us again the main points for next week, bearing in mind that Friday is a holiday.

utterances.speaker: MR. WITHOPF
utterances.text: For this purpose, could we please go into closed session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well. Madam Registrar, can we go into private session, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: Blank page inserted to ensure pagination corresponds between the French and English transcripts.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] We are in open session. You have the floor.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. President, in connection with the document which the Defence showed the witness Eminovic and which has DH128 ID, the problem arose with regard to the front page, and the Trial Chamber instructed the Defence to provide an explanation. We have instructed our investigator to send us a scanned page electronically of the document which is in the BH archives, and we also received a statement by the head of the archives of Bosnia and Herzegovina that the mentioned document is in the archives in this form. As this statement and document has been translated, I would now like to ask this document and statement to be handed to the Trial Chamber. During the break, we gave the document to the Prosecution. We also asked them whether they needed an electronic version as well. They told us that the document they have received would suffice. And I think that the questions raised in connection with this document have been resolved, and we should now like to tender this document into evidence.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well. The document that was discussed several days ago had problems linked to the photocopy. The Defence tells us that the document comes from the archives of Bosnia-Herzegovina and is producing a statement to that effect by the official responsible for the army archives and which -- and this statement has been translated. Does the Prosecution still have any reservations regarding this document that was marked for identification, or can it now become an exhibit, in view of what has been done to authenticate the said document?

utterances.speaker: MR. WITHOPF
utterances.text: Mr. President, Your Honours, after the explanation given by my learned friend from the Hadzihasanovic Defence, there are no objections.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well. In those circumstances, the ID number becomes an exhibit number. So, Madam Registrar, please make sure that this document now has an exhibit number, both in B/C/S and in English. Simply, we need to attach to the document that was originally tendered the new document that we received today. And it, too, should be given a number. So we need four exhibit numbers, in fact, the original document plus the others.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: So for this DH128 ID will become DH128; and the next document will be DH129. Blank page inserted to ensure pagination corresponds between the French and English transcripts.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes. But as we have them in B/C/S and in English, DH129/E and the other one /BCS. In any event, in the meantime we have taken note of the fact that the document that was DH128 ID becomes DH128, and the new document is DH129. I wish to thank everyone attending the hearing today, and I invite you to come back on Monday at 2.15.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Monday, the 26th day of April, 2004, at 2.15 p.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 12.08 p.m.,
